caption:
Still waiting for your dua to be answered?

Zakariyya cried out to his Lord, and Allah answered his prayer. Allah describes his family as people who hastened to do good and called upon Him with hope and fear, humble before Him.

Surah Al-Anbiyaa 21:89-90

Send this to someone who has made the same dua for years.

#dua #zakariya #surahanbiya #hopeinallah

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: And [remember] Zachariah, when he cried out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me childless, for You are the Best of Inheritors.” So We answered his prayer and gave him John, and made his wife fertile. They used to hasten in doing good deeds and used to call upon Us with hope and fear, and they were humble before Us (Surah Al-Anbiyaa 21:89-90)
theme: dua with hope / Zakariyya's prayer answered
